description: The converter marks every member named like an access key sensitive, which catches the S3 file ingest source's `accessKeyId` in `CloudStorageCredentials.basicAwsCredentials` and its patch arm. The spec describes it as "AWS access key ID": the public half of the key pair, an identifier like a key ID, while `secretAccessKey` ("AWS secret access key") stays sensitive. IDs stay plain strings (distilled-sdk skill, Credentials). Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://galaxy.starburst.io/public/openapi/v1/json (2026-11-12); no live call.
